newsitem.title: USA: Mobilemedia bid for FCC hearing stay nixed.
newsitem.headline: Mobilemedia bid for FCC hearing stay nixed.

text.p: MobileMedia Corp said Monday its request for a stay of hearings ordered by the Federal Communications Commission has been denied by an administrative law judge of the agency.

MobileMedia filed a motion for a stay on April 23. The FCC on April 7 instituted the proceedings to ascertain the qualifications of the paging company to retain its licenses after finding that at least 289 forms filed with the agency allegedly misrepresented the status of paging stations.

MobileMedia said it will appeal the law judge's decision to the full commission. It said that if the law judge's decision is not reversed, it will proceed with the hearing process under the FCC order.
MobileMedia, which is operating under a U.S. bankruptcy court's debtor-in-possession order previously said it could be fined or lose its license if it loses the FCC case.
